operationRecipe: One fresh actual original UI/local API context per error/no-op/stop family; reuse existing pending successful job for busy where possible. Hydrate real panel/rAF first, clear setup request trace, retain exact notifications container and original timers. Use valid LibraryRecord with createdAt. No private helper export/invocation or parser/local module replacement.
wireDeltaBoundary: Lists describe post-hydration UI wire deltas with real local API. Ingest success/cancellation/no-op includes local API post-ingest stats then UI finally stats. Pre-index/no usable has only UI finally stats. Abort is side channel with no reply. Failed ingest queue blocks follow-up stats. Freeze actual ordering before assertions.
protocolNotes: Worker ready/list use actual typed LibraryRecord including createdAt
Abort with no pending ingest is valid and must not manufacture ingest_done
No-op/cancel before saving returns ingest_done without commit; ordinary transaction emits saving and waits for actual client commit before done
Stop-before-indexing capture must include actual loading text observer and no ingest; if scheduling misses this, report uncaptured rather than force stop flag
Worker error case runs alone because real send queue remains rejected; never reset domain queue inside driver
